additional_info.subject: Incident on SICHARGE D charger – Connector 2 fault (SID Y2/S2 313522141002)
additional_info.body:
Hello,
I would like to report an issue on the charging station SID Y2/S2 313522141002 installed at Dufour Entrepôt (St Jean de Folleville - Le Havre).
The Connector 2 (DC CCS, 160 kW) is in fault with the following message:
•     Vendor specific error
•     VendorErrorCode: secc is offline
•     Last status update: 22/09/2025 at 17:33:25
Communication with the charger is established (last communication: 22/09/2025 at 18:28:14), but the connector remains in fault state.
Could you please investigate and provide corrective actions to resolve the root cause and prevent recurrence?
Thank you for your support.
Best regards,
Malek DRIF | Head of Operations | Mob:
+33 650 370 485
SAS AUTORECHARGE |
WWW.AUTORECHARGE.FR
|
+33 970 755 400
Design and installation of EV charging equipment and infrastructure

additional_info.subject: RE: Incident on SICHARGE D charger – Connector 2 fault (SID Y2/S2 313522141002) CRM:00271001006
additional_info.body:
Bonjour Malek,
Le problème venait d’une perte de communication avec le camion. Il est possible que le contrôleur du véhicule ait perdu la connexion avec le chargeur. Je leur conseille de maintenir leur camion à jour et de bien nettoyer les broches des connecteurs.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen/ Best regards,Francois WINCKEL
